# Copilot repository instructions

Read and follow the repository-wide agent instructions in [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before proposing or applying changes.

`AGENTS.md` is the canonical source for:

- the intentional `uv` environment policy;
- Ruff/CI enforcement rules;
- semantic validation of educational exercises beyond green asserts;
- fail-closed Git/synchronization concurrency rules;
- notebook metadata/output hygiene;
- security and secret-handling requirements.

Also follow [../CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [../SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Do not duplicate or reinterpret those policies here; if they change, `AGENTS.md` remains authoritative.
